_meta.principle: HUMAN-FACE-ONLY presets to prevent the plastic AI-face problem. Cinematic skin has pores, slight imperfection, subsurface warmth, real shadow geometry. Default AI generation tends to over-smooth toward waxy. These presets push back. ONLY pasted into prompt when subject_type ∈ {human, mixed}.
sources: Higgsfield AI tutorial transcript 2026-05-03 (texture mention as part of cinematic image)
_meta.interpolation_rule: Paste fragment verbatim into the skin-texture clause. Composer skips this entirely if subject_type is product/environment.

DD.seeded_from: CLAUDE.md DD: premium honest skin (when humans appear)

RH.seeded_from: CLAUDE.md RH: slow fashion real-people honest portraiture

HR.seeded_from: CLAUDE.md HR: brand creatives soft skin without plastic

natural_pores_subtle_imperfection.name: Natural pores, subtle imperfection
natural_pores_subtle_imperfection.use: Default for any human subject in non-stylized work. Real skin texture, visible pores, subtle blemishes / freckles / fine lines preserved.
natural_pores_subtle_imperfection.fragment: natural skin texture with visible pores, subtle imperfections preserved (freckles, fine lines, faint blemishes), real subsurface warmth, NOT smoothed or retouched, NOT plastic, NOT waxy

cinematic_film_grain_skin.name: Cinematic skin under film grain
cinematic_film_grain_skin.use: Film-grain aesthetic. Skin reads slightly grainy and organic, the way faces look on Kodak Vision3 or 500T stock.
cinematic_film_grain_skin.fragment: skin rendered with subtle film grain, organic photo-chemical texture, the slight noise of high-ISO film stock embedded in the skin, NOT digital smooth, NOT plastic

soft_portrait_smooth_no_plastic.name: Soft beauty portrait WITHOUT plastic
soft_portrait_smooth_no_plastic.use: When the look calls for softer skin (beauty, wellness brand, magazine cover) but the AI tendency to over-smooth must be checked.
soft_portrait_smooth_no_plastic.fragment: softly lit skin with gentle smoothing of fine texture but pores still visible at close inspection, organic subsurface warmth maintained, NOT airbrushed flat, NOT waxy, NOT plastic — soft beauty without losing humanity
soft_portrait_smooth_no_plastic.warning: Easy to drift toward plastic. Pair with warning prompt phrases. Avoid stacking with `clamshell_portrait` lighting unless explicitly tested.

documentary_unretouched.name: Documentary unretouched
documentary_unretouched.use: Hard-news, journalism, real-people portraiture. Show every line, every imperfection. The opposite of beauty retouching.
documentary_unretouched.fragment: completely unretouched skin, every line and imperfection visible, the character of real lived faces preserved, no smoothing, no airbrushing, the honest texture of documentary photography

aged_weathered_character.name: Aged weathered character
aged_weathered_character.use: Older subjects, outdoor workers, people with stories on their faces. Push deep lines, sun damage, character.
aged_weathered_character.fragment: deeply weathered skin with character lines, sun-aged texture, visible folds and depth in older skin, the lived-in quality of a face that has spent time outdoors, every line a story

youthful_clear_no_smoothing.name: Youthful clear (no smoothing)
youthful_clear_no_smoothing.use: Younger subjects whose skin is naturally clearer. Render that clarity honestly without artificial smoothing.
youthful_clear_no_smoothing.fragment: naturally clear young skin, fine pore texture still visible at close inspection, healthy subsurface warmth, the genuine clarity of youthful skin, NOT artificially smoothed, NOT plastic
